title: Light Crispy Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A delicious and healthy Australian dish featuring lamb skewers with a sour and cheesy flavor, perfect for a quick meal prep, this recipe combines the freshness of fennel seeds with the convenience of air frying, making it a great option for a mediterranean friendly meal
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Sprinkle the fennel seeds over the lamb and toss again to combine.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Cook the lamb skewers in the air fryer for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, mix the shredded mozzarella cheese with chopped parsley.
Once the lamb is done, remove it from the air fryer and top each skewer with a spoonful of the cheese mixture.
Return the skewers to the air fryer and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and crispy.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
